Subject: Trial initiation & kickoff: scheduling next steps with Zenwell

Hi Lena and Rajiv —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the trial kicked off quickly: 

- Goal: 2-week evaluation of Redwood inference pipeline on sample workload (billing + clinical summarization prompts).
- Success criteria (draft): average 95th-pct latency < 200ms for common prompt paths, cost/run below target $X per 1k tokens, no PII retention beyond session. Please confirm or add.
- What we need from your side: small prompt set (5–10 canonical prompts), an example dataset slice (~200 records), and a security point-of-contact for SOC2 evidence exchange.

Proposed kickoff windows (PT) — please pick two that work and I’ll send the calendar invite: 
1) Mon Sep 20, 10:00–10:45
2) Mon Sep 20, 14:00–14:45
3) Tue Sep 21, 09:00–09:45

I attached a short trial plan and the data-processing matrix so your security team can scan while we confirm timing. I’ll loop in Aisha (solutions engineer) for the deep-dive and Monica (CS) for success criteria and onboarding.

Next steps: tell us preferred slot, add any additional stakeholders, and upload the prompt set to the shared Drive link or paste in your reply.

Thanks —
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132

Attachments (2): zenwell_trial_plan_v1.pdf (6 pages), redwood-data-processing-matrix.xlsx

- Security POC: copying our InfoSec lead, Priya Kumar (priya.kumar@zenwell.ai) — she will request the SOC2 and architecture notes if needed.

Procurement is copied for PO timing — Rajiv, Priya, and I will be on the kickoff.

Thanks — and welcome, Procurement. Quick answers inline: 

1) Telemetry: For this evaluation, no third-party cookies or external telemetry will be sent outside your environment without prior confirmation. The attached data-processing matrix spells out the minimal monitoring events we collect (service-level metrics, anonymized token counts) and options to disable telemetry entirely for the trial.

2) SOC2: attaching our SOC2 summary and a link to the full SOC2 Type II binder for secure download. If you'd prefer a direct SFTP, we can arrange it.

I've attached: zenwell_trial_plan_v1.pdf, redwood-data-processing-matrix.xlsx, SOC2-summary.pdf (uploaded to secure link).

Confirmed kickoff invite: Mon Sep 20, 14:00–14:45 PT — calendar invite sent (https://calendar.redwood.com/invite/zenwell-kickoff-0920). Agenda (brief): intros (5m), trial scope + success criteria (10m), infra & data flow (15m), SE deep-dive & next steps (15m).

Aisha and Monica will join the call to handle the technical and operational items. Looking forward to it.

Regards,
